title: Claude Code vs OpenAI Codex: Which AI Coding Agent Should You Use?
summary: Claude Code vs OpenAI Codex compared: terminal agent vs cloud agent. Pricing, autonomy, use cases — plus the full-stack option developers actually ship with.
body_markdown: Claude Code runs locally with deep interactive codebase access; Codex runs in the cloud with async parallel task handling. Claude Code adapts to your existing codebase better; Codex is easier to start with and better for batch work. Both write code — neither ships the backend infrastructure needed to turn that code into a live product. If that gap matters to you,[Blink](https://blink.new/) is the path that closes it: full-stack builder with database, auth, and deploy included.
